article.headline: Games To Watch: St. Andrew's takes unbeaten start to Northeast Jones; Grenada hosts Canton
article.html:
St. Andrew's Episcopal brings an unbeaten start and a defense yet to concede to Laurel on Monday, November 2. The Saints enter their boys soccer match at Northeast Jones at 2–0, with nine goals scored and none allowed in their reported opening matches. Kickoff is scheduled for 7 p.m. CST.

Earlier in the evening, Grenada hosts Canton at 6:30 p.m. CST. The Chargers enter 2–2 after a 3–1 win over Cleveland Central on Saturday, while Canton is listed at 0–1. The two matches offer a look at teams trying to build on different early-season starts.

St. Andrew's takes its unbeaten start to Northeast Jones

For St. Andrew's, the record is backed by results at home and away: the Saints are 1–0 in each setting. Their nine goals for and none against give the visit to Northeast Jones a clear point of interest—whether that defensive start holds up on another road trip.

Northeast Jones enters 1–1, with both reported results coming away from home and a 0–0 home record. Monday's scheduled home match gives the Tigers a chance to test that unbeaten visiting side. The meeting is listed as non-district.

Grenada hosts Canton after Saturday's win

Grenada's 3–1 victory over Cleveland Central restored its record to 2–2. The Chargers are 1–1 at home entering the Canton match, so the immediate question is whether they can follow Saturday's result with another win. Our October 31 soccer recap covers the Cleveland Central result.

Canton arrives seeking its first win in the reported season record. Its 0–1 start makes this an early opportunity to respond, while Grenada has a recent victory to build on. The match is listed as non-district and starts half an hour before the St. Andrew's–Northeast Jones meeting.
